# Peep

> Peep is a debugger for PHP apps (PHP 7.1 to 8.5, Laravel 5.5 to 13). The app calls `peep($value)`, and values, queries, exceptions, jobs, logs, mail and SMS show up live in the Peep viewer: a desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux, or `peep-server.phar` in a browser. Composer package: `shibbirweb/peep` (a dev dependency).

## Install

- [Installing Peep for a user, step by step for AI agents](https://github.com/shibbirweb/peep/blob/HEAD/llms-install.md): find the version, install the viewer for the user's system, add the package, turn it on, prove it works.
- [README](https://github.com/shibbirweb/peep/blob/HEAD/README.md): the same for people.

## Use

- [Debugging with Peep, for AI agents](https://github.com/shibbirweb/peep/blob/HEAD/resources/skills/peep/SKILL.md): the Peep skill. `vendor/bin/peep report`, `cards`, `mail`, `sms`, `logs`, `wait`, `clear`, and `vendor/bin/peep mcp` for MCP.
- [API reference](https://github.com/shibbirweb/peep/blob/HEAD/docs/wiki/usage/API-Reference.md): every method of `peep()`.
- [Laravel](https://github.com/shibbirweb/peep/blob/HEAD/docs/wiki/usage/Laravel.md), [Configuration](https://github.com/shibbirweb/peep/blob/HEAD/docs/wiki/usage/Configuration.md), [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/shibbirweb/peep/blob/HEAD/docs/wiki/usage/Troubleshooting.md).

## Work on Peep itself

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/shibbirweb/peep/blob/HEAD/AGENTS.md): the rules for changing Peep's code.
